verdicts.reason: A: the bottom is cramped into a three-column row. The subcopy is squeezed into a narrow 4-line column, and the legal text is a tiny, ragged 7-line column jammed beside the CTA. The bottle floats off-axis on the left with dead space to its right, and the logo and ribbon sit at unrelated heights. B: keeps a clear centered top-to-bottom reading order with a strong CTA.
